1  	# Building qs
2  	
3  	qs is a small C library (`libqs`) with two command-line programs built on it: `colstat`, which
4  	prints summary statistics for the columns of a delimited file, and `qcalc`, which evaluates
5  	arithmetic expressions. This document is the build contract. Release engineering checks every
6  	rule below on a clean checkout before a release is tagged.
7  	
8  	## 1. Toolchain
9  	
10 	- GNU make 4.3 and gcc 12 (C11). No other build system is used.
11 	- `sh`, `awk`, `sed`, `ar` and `install` from the base system. The build finds them through
12 	  `PATH`; it does not use absolute paths for them.
13 	- `CC` can be overridden on the command line (`make CC=...`); every compile and link goes
14 	  through `$(CC)`.
15 	
16 	## 2. Source layout
17 	
18 	| Path | Contents |
19 	|---|---|
20 	| `include/qs/` | Public headers of the library. Hand-written only. |
21 	| `lib/<module>/` | Library sources, one directory per module. A module may keep private headers next to its sources. |
22 	| `tools/colstat/`, `tools/qcalc/` | The programs. |
23 	| `src/ops.def` | The operation table of the expression evaluator (see section 4). |
24 	| `VERSION` | The release version, `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` on the first line. |
25 	| `build-aux/` | Generator scripts used by the build. |
26 	| `tests/unit/` | Unit tests. Every `tests/unit/*.c` file is part of the unit test program; tests register themselves (see `tests/unit/unit.h`). |
27 	| `tests/golden/` | Golden cases for the programs (see section 7). |
28 	| `man/` | Manual pages, one per program. |
29 	| `qs.pc.in` | Template of the pkg-config file. |
30 	| `mk/` | Makefile fragments included by the top-level `Makefile`. |
31 	
32 	The library is every `.c` file under `lib/`; each program is every `.c` file in its directory under
33 	`tools/`. Adding a source file to one of those directories adds it to the build without editing
34 	the makefiles.
35 	
36 	## 3. Build output
37 	
38 	Everything the build writes goes under `build/` and nowhere else:
39 	
40 	| Path | Contents |
41 	|---|---|
42 	| `build/gen/qs/` | Generated headers. |
43 	| `build/obj/` | Object files and dependency files, mirroring the source paths. |
44 	| `build/lib/libqs.a` | The static library. |
45 	| `build/bin/colstat`, `build/bin/qcalc` | The programs. |
46 	| `build/tests/` | Test programs and logs. |
47 	
48 	`make clean` removes `build/`. A clean tree is the source tree without `build/`.
49 	
50 	## 4. Generated headers
51 	
52 	Two headers are generated during the build. Neither is ever kept in the source tree, edited by
53 	hand, or committed; a copy outside `build/gen` is a defect, because it can be found before the
54 	generated one.
55 	
56 	| Header | Generated from | By |
57 	|---|---|---|
58 	| `build/gen/qs/version.h` | `VERSION` | `build-aux/mkversion.sh VERSION` (writes to standard output) |
59 	| `build/gen/qs/ops.h` | `src/ops.def` | `build-aux/genops.sh src/ops.def` (writes to standard output) |
60 	
61 	Sources include them as `"qs/version.h"` and `"qs/ops.h"`. `version.h` is public: the umbrella
62 	header `qs/qs.h` includes it, and it is installed. `ops.h` is internal to the library and is not
63 	installed.
64 	
65 	`src/ops.def` is the only definition of the operations: their names, symbols, arity, precedence
66 	and associativity. The programs must behave as that file says.
67 	
68 	## 5. Compiler flags
69 	
70 	There are two configurations. Both treat every warning as an error.
71 	
72 	| Configuration | How | Flags (in addition to the include paths) |
73 	|---|---|---|
74 	| Release | plain `make` | `-std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -O2 -DNDEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Werror` |
75 	| Debug | `make DEBUG=1` | `-std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -O0 -g3 -DQS_DEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Werror` |
76 	
77 	The debug configuration compiles extra tracing code (`QS_DEBUG`) and keeps `assert` active; the
78 	release configuration compiles out `assert` (`NDEBUG`). Code must compile cleanly under both.
79 	
80 	Warnings are fixed in the code. The build must not pass `-w`, any `-Wno-...` option, `-Wno-error`
81 	or `-fpermissive`, and sources must not use `#pragma GCC diagnostic` or similar pragmas to
82 	silence diagnostics. Fixing a warning must not change what the programs do: `docs/colstat.md`
83 	and `docs/qcalc.md` define their behavior, including for inputs the golden cases do not cover.
84 	
85 	## 6. Targets
86 	
87 	| Target | Result |
88 	|---|---|
89 	| `all` (first target) | The library and both programs, with the generated headers they need. |
90 	| `build/lib/libqs.a`, `build/bin/colstat`, `build/bin/qcalc` | That file and everything it needs. |
91 	| `check` | Builds what the tests need, runs the unit tests and the golden cases (section 7). |
92 	| `install` | Builds what it installs if needed, then installs (section 8). |
93 	| `clean` | Removes `build/`. |
94 	
95 	Rules every target follows:
96 	
97 	1. **Clean tree, any parallelism.** Each target above works when it is the first and only target
98 	   given on a clean tree, at any `-j` level, every time. A build that only works because make
99 	   happened to run jobs in a lucky order is broken. In practice: every file a recipe reads is a
100	   prerequisite of that recipe's target, or is produced before it by a prerequisite; no recipe
101	   relies on the order in which other targets are listed.
102	2. **Linking.** The programs link statically against `build/lib/libqs.a` and against the math
103	   library. Libraries come after the objects that use them on the link line.
104	3. **Incremental builds.** After any change to a source file, a header (hand-written or generated),
105	   `VERSION` or `src/ops.def`, running `make` again rebuilds everything that depends on the change,
106	   so that the programs and the library reflect it. Running `make` twice with nothing changed does
107	   nothing the second time: no compile, archive or link step runs.
108	
109	## 7. Tests
110	
111	`make check` runs two suites and exits with a non-zero status when any test in either suite fails:
112	
113	- The unit test program, built from every `tests/unit/*.c` file and `build/lib/libqs.a`. It exits
114	  non-zero when a check fails.
115	- The golden cases: `sh tests/golden.sh build/bin` runs each case in `tests/golden` and exits
116	  non-zero when a case fails. The case format is described at the top of `tests/golden.sh`.
117	
118	`make check` on a clean tree builds everything both suites need first.
119	
120	## 8. Installation
121	
122	`make install` honors two variables:
123	
124	- `PREFIX`, the installation prefix, `/usr/local` when not given.
125	- `DESTDIR`, prepended to every installed path (for staging and packaging), empty when not given.
126	
127	The installed tree under `$(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)` is exactly:
128	
129	| Path | Mode | Contents |
130	|---|---|---|
131	| `bin/colstat`, `bin/qcalc` | 0755 | The programs. |
132	| `lib/libqs.a` | 0644 | The static library. |
133	| `include/qs/*.h` | 0644 | Every public header (section 2), unchanged, plus the generated `version.h`. |
134	| `lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc` | 0644 | From `qs.pc.in`, with `@PREFIX@` replaced by the `PREFIX` given to `make install` and `@VERSION@` by the version. |
135	| `share/man/man1/*.1` | 0644 | The manual page of each program. |
136	
137	Nothing else is installed. The prefix recorded in `qs.pc` is the one given to `make install`, also
138	when the build itself ran earlier with another or no `PREFIX`. A program that includes `qs/qs.h`
139	from the installed `include` directory and links the installed `libqs.a` with `-lm` must build
140	and behave like the programs in `build/bin`.
141	
142	## 9. Typical use
143	
144	    make -j8
145	    make -j8 check
146	    make install PREFIX=/usr DESTDIR=/tmp/stage
147	    make DEBUG=1

# See docs/BUILDING.md for the targets and the rules the build follows.

.PHONY: all
all:

include mk/config.mk
include mk/gen.mk
include mk/lib.mk
include mk/tools.mk
include mk/check.mk
include mk/install.mk

all: gen lib tools $(PC_FILE)

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

config.mk
gen.mk
install.mk
lib.mk

# make check: unit tests, then the golden cases against the built programs.

UNIT_SRCS   := $(sort $(wildcard tests/unit/*.c))
UNIT_OBJS   := $(UNIT_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
UNIT_RUNNER := $(BUILD)/tests/unit_runner

$(UNIT_RUNNER): $(UNIT_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) $(UNIT_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(OBJDIR)/tests/%.o: tests/%.c
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(TOOL_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

.PHONY: check
check: $(UNIT_RUNNER)
	-$(UNIT_RUNNER)
	sh tests/golden.sh $(BINDIR) | tee $(BUILD)/golden.log
# Paths and flags shared by every fragment.

BUILD  := build
OBJDIR := $(BUILD)/obj
LIBDIR := $(BUILD)/lib
BINDIR := $(BUILD)/bin
GENDIR := $(BUILD)/gen

PREFIX ?= /usr/local

CC      = gcc
AR      = ar
ARFLAGS = rcs
INSTALL = install

STD  = -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L
WARN = -Wall -Wextra -Werror

ifeq ($(DEBUG),yes)
OPT = -O0 -g3 -DQS_DEBUG
else
OPT = -O2 -DNDEBUG
endif

CFLAGS = $(STD) $(OPT) $(WARN)

LIB_CPPFLAGS  = -Iinclude -Ilib -I$(GENDIR)
TOOL_CPPFLAGS = -Iinclude

LDLIBS = -lm
# Generated headers.

GEN_OPS := $(GENDIR)/qs/ops.h

.PHONY: gen
gen: $(GEN_OPS)

$(GEN_OPS): src/ops.def build-aux/genops.sh
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sh build-aux/genops.sh src/ops.def > $@.tmp
	mv $@.tmp $@
# make install [PREFIX=...] [DESTDIR=...]

PC_FILE := $(BUILD)/qs.pc

$(PC_FILE): qs.pc.in VERSION
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sed -e 's|@PREFIX@|$(PREFIX)|g' -e "s|@VERSION@|$$(cat VERSION)|g" qs.pc.in > $@

.PHONY: install
install: all
	$(INSTALL) -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig
	$(INSTALL) -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/qs $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/share/man/man1
	$(INSTALL) -m 755 $(BINS) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(LIBQS) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 include/qs/*.h $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/qs
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(PC_FILE) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 man/colstat.1 $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/share/man/man1
# libqs.a

LIB_SRCS := $(sort $(wildcard lib/*/*.c))
LIB_OBJS := $(LIB_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
LIBQS    := $(LIBDIR)/libqs.a

.PHONY: lib
lib: $(LIBQS)

$(LIBQS): $(LIB_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	rm -f $@
	$(AR) $(ARFLAGS) $@ $^

$(OBJDIR)/lib/%.o: lib/%.c
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LIB_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
# colstat and qcalc

COLSTAT_SRCS := $(sort $(wildcard tools/colstat/*.c))
QCALC_SRCS   := $(sort $(wildcard tools/qcalc/*.c))
COLSTAT_OBJS := $(COLSTAT_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
QCALC_OBJS   := $(QCALC_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
BINS         := $(BINDIR)/colstat $(BINDIR)/qcalc

.PHONY: tools
tools: $(BINS)

$(BINDIR)/colstat: $(COLSTAT_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) $(LDLIBS) $(LIBQS) $(COLSTAT_OBJS) -o $@

$(BINDIR)/qcalc: $(QCALC_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) $(LDLIBS) $(LIBQS) $(QCALC_OBJS) -o $@

$(OBJDIR)/tools/%.o: tools/%.c
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(TOOL_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

# Paths and flags shared by every fragment.

BUILD  := build
OBJDIR := $(BUILD)/obj
LIBDIR := $(BUILD)/lib
BINDIR := $(BUILD)/bin
GENDIR := $(BUILD)/gen

PREFIX ?= /usr/local
DESTDIR ?=

CC      = gcc
AR      = ar
ARFLAGS = rcs
INSTALL = install

STD  = -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L
WARN = -Wall -Wextra -Werror

# DEBUG=1 selects the debug configuration; empty, 0 or no selects release.
ifneq ($(filter-out 0 no NO false,$(strip $(DEBUG))),)
OPT = -O0 -g3 -DQS_DEBUG
else
OPT = -O2 -DNDEBUG
endif

CFLAGS = $(STD) $(OPT) $(WARN)

# Dependency file generation (headers, hand-written or generated).
DEPFLAGS = -MMD -MP

LIB_CPPFLAGS  = -Iinclude -Ilib -I$(GENDIR)
TOOL_CPPFLAGS = -Iinclude -I$(GENDIR)

LDLIBS = -lm

.DELETE_ON_ERROR:

# Records the compiler and flags in use, so that switching configuration
# (for example DEBUG=1) rebuilds every object. The file is only rewritten
# when its content changes.
FLAGS_STAMP := $(BUILD)/.flags

.PHONY: FORCE
FORCE:

$(FLAGS_STAMP): FORCE
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	@printf '%s\n' '$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS)' | cmp -s - $@ || printf '%s\n' '$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS)' > $@

# Generated headers. They live in build/gen only.

GEN_OPS     := $(GENDIR)/qs/ops.h
GEN_VERSION := $(GENDIR)/qs/version.h
GEN_HDRS    := $(GEN_OPS) $(GEN_VERSION)

.PHONY: gen
gen: $(GEN_HDRS)

$(GEN_OPS): src/ops.def build-aux/genops.sh
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sh build-aux/genops.sh src/ops.def > $@.tmp || { rm -f $@.tmp; exit 1; }
	mv $@.tmp $@

$(GEN_VERSION): VERSION build-aux/mkversion.sh
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sh build-aux/mkversion.sh VERSION > $@.tmp || { rm -f $@.tmp; exit 1; }
	mv $@.tmp $@

# libqs.a

LIB_SRCS := $(sort $(shell find lib -name '*.c'))
LIB_OBJS := $(LIB_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
LIBQS    := $(LIBDIR)/libqs.a

.PHONY: lib
lib: $(LIBQS)

$(LIBQS): $(LIB_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	rm -f $@
	$(AR) $(ARFLAGS) $@ $(LIB_OBJS)

$(OBJDIR)/lib/%.o: lib/%.c $(FLAGS_STAMP) | $(GEN_HDRS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LIB_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) $(DEPFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

-include $(LIB_OBJS:.o=.d)

# colstat and qcalc

COLSTAT_SRCS := $(sort $(wildcard tools/colstat/*.c))
QCALC_SRCS   := $(sort $(wildcard tools/qcalc/*.c))
COLSTAT_OBJS := $(COLSTAT_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
QCALC_OBJS   := $(QCALC_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
BINS         := $(BINDIR)/colstat $(BINDIR)/qcalc

.PHONY: tools
tools: $(BINS)

$(BINDIR)/colstat: $(COLSTAT_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) -static $(COLSTAT_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(BINDIR)/qcalc: $(QCALC_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) -static $(QCALC_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(OBJDIR)/tools/%.o: tools/%.c $(FLAGS_STAMP) | $(GEN_HDRS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(TOOL_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) $(DEPFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

-include $(COLSTAT_OBJS:.o=.d) $(QCALC_OBJS:.o=.d)

# make check: unit tests, then the golden cases against the built programs.

UNIT_SRCS   := $(sort $(wildcard tests/unit/*.c))
UNIT_OBJS   := $(UNIT_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
UNIT_RUNNER := $(BUILD)/tests/unit_runner

$(UNIT_RUNNER): $(UNIT_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) $(UNIT_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(OBJDIR)/tests/%.o: tests/%.c $(FLAGS_STAMP) | $(GEN_HDRS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(TOOL_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) $(DEPFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

-include $(UNIT_OBJS:.o=.d)

.PHONY: check
check: $(UNIT_RUNNER) $(BINS)
	@mkdir -p $(BUILD)/tests
	@rc=0; \
	$(UNIT_RUNNER) > $(BUILD)/tests/unit.log 2>&1 || rc=1; \
	cat $(BUILD)/tests/unit.log; \
	sh tests/golden.sh $(BINDIR) > $(BUILD)/tests/golden.log 2>&1 || rc=1; \
	cat $(BUILD)/tests/golden.log; \
	exit $$rc

# make install [PREFIX=...] [DESTDIR=...]

MANPAGES := $(sort $(wildcard man/*.1))
PUBLIC_HEADERS := $(sort $(wildcard include/qs/*.h))

.PHONY: install
install: all
	$(INSTALL) -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig
	$(INSTALL) -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/qs $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/share/man/man1
	$(INSTALL) -m 755 $(BINS) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(LIBQS) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(PUBLIC_HEADERS) $(GEN_VERSION) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/qs
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(MANPAGES) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/share/man/man1
	sed -e 's|@PREFIX@|$(PREFIX)|g' -e "s|@VERSION@|$$(sed -n '1{s/[[:space:]]//g;p;}' VERSION)|g" qs.pc.in > $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc
	chmod 644 $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc

# qs: the libqs statistics and expression library, colstat and qcalc.
# See docs/BUILDING.md for the targets and the rules the build follows.

.PHONY: all
all:

include mk/config.mk
include mk/gen.mk
include mk/lib.mk
include mk/tools.mk
include mk/check.mk
include mk/install.mk

all: gen lib tools

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

steps.message:
The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md`, and I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

I checked these on a clean tree:
- **Targets:** `make -j8` works for `all`, `build/lib/libqs.a`, `build/bin/colstat`, `build/bin/qcalc`, `check` and `install`, each run alone after `make clean`.
- **Tests:** `make check` runs 22 unit tests and 34 golden cases with no failures, and returns a non-zero exit when either suite fails.
- **Debug build:** `make DEBUG=1` and `make DEBUG=1 check` both pass.
- **Install:** `make install PREFIX=/usr DESTDIR=/tmp/stage` installs exactly the files the contract lists, with the right modes. `qs.pc` records `/usr` and version 2.4.1. A test program built against the installed header and `libqs.a` with `-lm` ran correctly.
- **Incremental builds:** a second `make` runs no compile, archive or link step. Changing `VERSION`, `src/ops.def` or a header rebuilds what depends on it.

**Makefile problems fixed**
- `version.h` was never generated, so nothing that included `qs/qs.h` could compile.
- A stale hand-written `include/qs/ops.h` shadowed the generated one. It was missing `hypot` and `clamp` and had wrong precedences, so I deleted it.
- `DEBUG=1` was ignored, because the makefile tested for `DEBUG=yes`.
- Link lines put the libraries before the objects, and the programs weren't linked statically.
- Dependency tracking was missing, and the programs didn't depend on the library.
- `check` ignored unit test failures and lost the golden suite's exit status through `tee`.
- `install` skipped `qcalc.1` and the generated `version.h`, and `qs.pc` was built at `all` time with whatever `PREFIX` was set then.

I fixed every warning in the code. The behavior changes are:
- **`qcalc` prefix minus:** its operand now extends only over operators with strictly higher precedence than `neg`, as `docs/qcalc.md` says. The current `src/ops.def` gives the same results either way.
- **`colstat -c`:** an unknown column is now caught with `idx >= 0` instead of an `int`/`size_t` comparison that only worked by accident.
- **`--max-size`:** the size suffix is parsed without fall-through. A value that overflows `size_t` now saturates instead of wrapping, so `--max-size 17179869184g` no longer wraps to a limit of 0. A number too large for `strtoull` is still rejected as invalid, as before.

I also tried `qcalc` and `colstat` on inputs outside `/app/tests`. These covered error messages, quoted fields, CRLF, tab delimiters, size limits and exit codes, and all matched the docs.

I left the tree clean with `make clean`.
